instruction: Add the Rotary Embeddings article to your bookmarks bar.

metadata.explanation: Task requires the user to bookmark the Rotary Embeddings article (first tab) to the bookmarks bar. Uses custom is_expected_bookmarks metric with subset checking to verify the URL is present, allowing for pre-existing or additional bookmarks without failing evaluation.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses subset checking to verify the Rotary Embeddings URL is present in the bookmark bar
Metric function at chrome.py:44 uses 'set(expected_urls).issubset(set(bookmark_bar_websites_urls))' which correctly allows additional bookmarks to exist
Instruction semantics match evaluator logic: 'Bookmark the article' (add requirement) is verified by checking presence, not exact match
Postconfig is present and appropriate: restarts Chrome to ensure bookmarks are persisted and readable from the Bookmarks file
Expected value correctly specifies the Rotary Embeddings URL from the instruction
Getter 'get_bookmarks' correctly extracts bookmark data from Chrome's Bookmarks file, metric correctly parses the bookmark_bar structure
Edge cases handled: empty bookmarks returns 0.0 (line 27), pre-existing bookmarks allowed (subset check), additional bookmarks allowed
